stem: What message is found in BOTH the selection "Public Speaking Is Easier When a Cute Dog Is Listening" and the poem "Assembly"?
instruction: Use "Public Speaking Is Easier When a Cute Dog Is Listening" and "Assembly" to answer the following question.

options.label: A
options.text: People should perform only when they feel prepared.

options.label: B
options.text: Picturing animals helps people feel relaxed when performing.

options.label: C
options.text: It takes effort to perform in front of others.

options.label: D
options.text: It is normal to need more practice when trying something new.
